title: - A Framework for Switchable LLM Alignment via CITA – Contrastive Instruction-Tuned Alignment
benchmark_measurement: The paper did not measure any aspects related to faith or religion.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a focus of the research. The study concentrates on the mechanisms of switchable and instruction-governed alignment in language models.
